regions.name: Product as hero
regions.note: One real product, one flat field, hard light.

families.name: Giant type hero
families.rule: The product sits in front of a word that fills the poster.
families.use: A product to sell and one loud word or two.

families.name: Witty object
families.rule: The product becomes the thing the line says.
families.use: The line can be shown literally: the product or an object becomes the joke.

families.name: Torn reveal
families.rule: Torn paper shows the flavour or story inside.
families.use: Showing what's inside: the flavour, the story, the new thing under the old.

families.name: Ingredient field
families.rule: The ingredient fills the frame edge to edge.
families.use: Freshness, origin or texture is the selling point.

families.name: Flash still life
families.rule: A set in the product's colour, hard flash shadows.
families.use: A premium mood: the product staged in a world of its own colour.

families.name: Hand-held
families.rule: A hand raises the product into saturated colour.
families.use: A human moment with the product, simple and bright.

regions.name: Print & editorial
regions.note: Paper, grain and grid carry the mood.

families.name: Editorial print
families.rule: Paper grain, halftone, pasted photo panels.
families.use: Mood and attitude over product: paper, grain and big statements.

families.name: Catalogue grid
families.rule: Strict modules, thin rules, small metadata.
families.use: Calm premium information: specs, a range, a timeline.

families.name: Illustration
families.rule: A painted object and hand lettering.
families.use: No photo needed, or the brand wants a warm handmade feel.

regions.name: Indian culture
regions.note: Real material culture, never a generic pattern.

families.name: Culture collage
families.rule: Dense real objects around one calm hero.
families.use: Indian pop culture, loud and dense, around one calm product.

families.name: Culture graphic
families.rule: A ritual object turned into a pop graphic.
families.use: A festival or ritual turned into a pop graphic, never diya-and-gold templates.

families.name: Culture editorial
families.rule: An unexpected local subject in a magazine layout.
families.use: A real local place or people, quiet and specific, magazine-like.

regions.name: People & events
regions.note: A face or an offer leads.

families.name: Film portrait
families.rule: A person on a flat field, the title taller than them.
families.use: A person leads: a face on a flat colour with a title taller than them.

families.name: Event flyer
families.rule: Offer, date and contacts in a tidy hierarchy.
families.use: There's an offer, a date and contacts that must read clearly.

regions.name: Photo play
regions.note: A real photo plus one hand-made layer: letters, doodles, stickers or broken scale.

families.name: Lettering wrap
families.rule: Hand-made letters wrap the person, some behind, some in front.
families.use: A person and a line of words: hand-made letters weave around them.

families.name: Doodle overlay
families.rule: Cartoon doodles come out of a real photo and play with it.
families.use: A real photo that needs fun: food or clothes come alive as cartoons.

families.name: Surreal scale
families.rule: Scale breaks: a giant head, a toy body, a person inside a bag.
families.use: The idea is a size joke: giant, tiny, a person inside an object.

families.name: Sticker cover
families.rule: A cut-out subject with stickers and cover metadata on a flat field.
families.use: A cut-out subject dressed with stickers like a cover or merch drop.

families.name: Type in place
families.rule: The words are a real object in a real place.
families.use: The words become a real object in a real place.

regions.name: Digital break
regions.note: Screen language — pixels, grids, UI chrome, glitches — cut into a real photo.

families.name: Pixel glitch
families.rule: Pixels or glitch blocks replace part of the face.
families.use: Mystery or digital edge: part of the face breaks into pixels.

families.name: Grid swap
families.rule: One subject split across a grid, each cell a new material.
families.use: One subject shown in many materials or versions on a strict grid.

families.name: Interface frame
families.rule: Real UI chrome frames the photo; the subject breaks out.
families.use: Screen life: real UI frames the photo and the subject breaks out.

families.name: Type window
families.rule: Giant letters are windows onto the photo; the subject pops out.
families.use: A big word that holds the photo, the subject bursting out of it.

families.name: Retro screen
families.rule: Something reaches out of an old computer into a collage world.
families.use: Nostalgic tech or internet ideas, collage around an old computer.

families.name: Floating UI
families.rule: Product screens float as glass panels around a real person.
families.use: A digital product launch: real app screens float around a person.
